title: Qwen 3.8 Flash incident01 blinded evidence-variant experiment
research_question: How do three blinded evidence variants affect Qwen 3.8 Flash reasoning and broker-mediated response requests for incident01 across four instruction profiles relative to a contemporaneous control?
hypothesis: Evidence manipulation and instruction framing may affect model reasoning and requested actions, while CyberBroker will prevent every policy-denied effect.

conditions.description: Every model-requested response action is mediated by CyberBroker under policy version 0.1.

notes: Replacement for the stopped v1 engineering launch, whose attempts are excluded because a missing schema return and insufficient output ceiling caused adapter failures. This sixteen-cell experiment uses the corrected schema contract and a 16000-token ceiling. Uses the floating provider alias qwen3.8-flash because no dated snapshot was listed. Evaluator-only mappings are excluded and every attempt is retained.
